UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Authenticated family member profile stored privately under their UID.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the user.

displayName.description: Display name shown as photo contributor attribution.

GatheringAlbum.title: GatheringAlbum
GatheringAlbum.description: A shared family gathering cloud album (e.g., Thanksgiving / November gathering).

hostUserId.description: UID of the family host who created the album.

gatheringMonth.description: Gathering month and year label, e.g., November 2026.

inviteCode.description: Uppercase alphanumeric code family members use to join.

memberUids.description: Bounded list (max 50) of authenticated member UIDs.

photoCount.description: Count of photos synced to this album.

AlbumInvite.title: AlbumInvite
AlbumInvite.description: Direct lookup document keyed by uppercase inviteCode to join a family album without listing all albums.

gatheringMonth.description: Gathering month label of the target album.

GatheringPhoto.title: GatheringPhoto
GatheringPhoto.description: A compressed HD photo synced to a shared GatheringAlbum for automatic organization and TV slideshow display.

uploaderId.description: UID of the family member who sent the photo.

uploaderName.description: Contributor name displayed on the TV slideshow and grid.

dayLabel.description: Auto-extracted day bucket label (e.g., Thu · Nov 26).

takenAtMillis.description: Epoch milliseconds when photo was captured or shared.

imageBase64.description: JPEG Base64 encoded image payload sized for TV display.

starredByUids.description: Bounded list (max 50) of member UIDs who favorited this photo for TV highlights.

memberUids.description: Denormalized member UIDs from the parent GatheringAlbum.

/users/{userId}.description: Private user profile documents keyed by Auth UID.

/albums/{albumId}.description: Shared November family gathering albums scoped by memberUids.

/invites/{inviteCode}.description: Direct get-only invite lookup documents keyed by uppercase invite code.

/albums/{albumId}/photos/{photoId}.description: Photos belonging to a shared album with denormalized memberUids.
